Backed dense X

Source: R/backed-dense.R
anndata-backed-dense.Rd

A backed_dense is a backed_x for a dense array on disk. [ accepts every R index form of a base matrix (positive, negative and logical vectors, repeated and unsorted positions, drop) and reads only the needed part of the file into memory. Python's dense handle rejects unsorted and repeated indices, here they are read as a sorted selection and then rearranged in memory. Values carry the On-disk dtype record, as for read_h5ad(). A vector index such as x[i] (or x[]) has no rows and columns to select, so it reads the whole array.

Arguments

x

A backed_dense.

i, j

Row and column indices, as for a base matrix.

drop

Whether a single row or column becomes a vector.
